# Ultra Home Repair — Irvine Tankless Water Heater Service

> Ultra Home Repair provides professional tankless water heater flushing, descaling, maintenance, and troubleshooting in Irvine, California. Owner Dustin Swad specializes in Rinnai tankless water heaters and also works on Rheem, Navien, and Noritz systems.

Ultra Home Repair is based in Woodbury and focuses its tankless water heater service on Irvine homeowners. Standard tankless water heater flushing is $125 for most standard residential units. Service typically takes 1 to 1.5 hours and includes a pre-flush visual inspection, professional heat-exchanger descaling, accessible inlet-filter cleaning, a post-flush rinse, restart verification, and service documentation.

Customers often contact Ultra Home Repair when a tankless water heater displays an error code, stops producing hot water, shuts down, develops reduced flow, takes longer to heat, or is overdue for maintenance. Some error codes and lockouts can be associated with scale buildup or maintenance issues, while others may require a different repair. Irvine homeowners can text a photo of the unit, its data plate, and the displayed error code to (949) 371-6423 for an initial assessment.

Primary brand specialty: Rinnai. Other brands serviced include Rheem, Navien, and Noritz. Ultra Home Repair uses original service photos, real Irvine customer reviews, transparent pricing, and direct owner-provided service.
